pip_cache.desc: Python package download cache. Regenerates on demand.

npm_cache.desc: Node.js package cache. Regenerates on demand.

nvidia_shader.desc: NVIDIA shader compilation cache. Regenerates when games launch.

windows_temp.desc: User temporary files. Safe to delete, OS recreates as needed.

windows_update.desc: Windows Update download cache. Needs admin rights. Safe to delete.

wechat_cache.desc: WeChat chat cache and file transfers. May lose chat history.

marvis_service.desc: Tencent Marvis background service. 10 processes, 695 threads.
marvis_service.clean_cmd: sc stop MarvisSvr & sc config MarvisSvr start=disabled
